messages:
jamie: Quick Friday poll — pick ONE item that best represents what’s actually in your backpack right now and why. Photo optional :camera_flash:

noah: power bank. always. my phone is a black hole for battery :battery:

sasha: tiny sketchbook. i scribble during calls. also crumbs. (no photo, respect the crumbs) :pencil2:

ben: collapsible umbrella. survived three unexpected monsoons. will take a picture if it hasn’t snapped open into a modern art piece yet :umbrella:

lina: pair of earbuds. also a hair tie. the hair tie is the real mvp. :headphones: :haircut:

alex: thermos with sad tea. refill frequency: variable. bonus: sticker of a dinosaur stuck to it :tea:

maria: a single granola bar that is somehow older than me. it’s a morale booster. :banana:

ops-bot: reminder: please label personal items before leaving them in the common area fridge. :bell:

noah: @sasha — now i want to see your sketchbook page. trade: i’ll show you a photo of my power bank that looks like a tiny brick. :grin:

sasha: upload in 2. teaching a doodle how-to in #random in 5? low effort, high payoff. :art: :ok_hand:

alex: small poll — would you rather have a backpack that fits everything but is heavy, or only the essentials and super light? vote with :one: or :two:

maria: :two: light for me. also less chance of impulse office-souvenir accumulation.

jamie: Results so far: power banks, tea, earbuds, and cursed snacks. the emotional arc of a backpack. thanks team, this is peak watercooler content. :heart:
